title: Diverse Human Value Alignment for Large Language Models via Ethical Reasoning
reasoning: The entire paper is centered on an 'ethical reasoning paradigm' for LLMs. It explicitly incorporates and evaluates four classical ethical theories—Deontology, Utilitarianism, Common Good, and Justice—as lenses for model deliberation and alignment. It also mentions evaluating queries spanning domains like religion and uses the SafeWorld benchmark for ethical judgment.
